shots.name: The Confusion
shots.visual: A student looking at two separate folders labeled 'B.Com' and 'BBA' on a desk, looking overwhelmed.
shots.dialogue: Choosing between B.Com and BBA feels impossible. You don't need a degree-guessing quiz; you need to see what you actually want to learn.
shots.cameraPerformance: Close-up on the student's expression, then pan to the folders.

shots.name: The Micro-Task
shots.visual: The student writes on a sticky note while looking at a sample task card: 'Draft a one-page marketing budget for a food stall'.
shots.dialogue: Try this: draft a simple food stall budget. Record where you get stuck. I found mine.
shots.onscreenText: Task: Draft a food stall budget.
shots.cameraPerformance: Over-the-shoulder shot showing the student writing on a sticky note.

shots.name: The Reveal
shots.visual: Close-up on the sticky note reading: 'Example: My hurdle: How to calculate fixed costs?'
shots.dialogue: See? My hurdle: How to calculate fixed costs? Now I have a real question.
shots.onscreenText: Example: My hurdle: How to calculate fixed costs?
shots.cameraPerformance: Focus pull onto the sticky note text.

shots.name: The Better Question
shots.visual: The student turns to the camera, looking relieved.
shots.dialogue: Stop guessing. Ask: Where can I find support for basic cost calculations?
shots.onscreenText: Where can I find support for basic cost calculations?

shots.cameraPerformance: Macro shot of the student sticking the note.

shots.name: The Better Question

shots.dialogue: Don't guess. Ask: Where can I find support for basic cost calculations? That's your next step.

qa.failureReason: integrity: Shot 3 shows the student sticking a post-it note onto the B.Com overview only, ignoring the BBA overview introduced in the hook.
